sup:70410.subject: Seal 24 mm (part 340010) – firm two-year commitment proposal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. We understand your capacity situation and would like to give you firm planning certainty.

We propose one complete package: EUR 29.89/unit, 23,400 units per year, binding for both years of a 24-month contract, retaining your quoted 54-day lead time. Payment 30 days net, DAP, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause and no tooling remain as enquired.

We are offering a firm commitment while keeping your delivery window. In exchange, we ask for full allocation of our requirement at this price.

Our buyer estimate is EUR 24.31/unit excluding margin, with 5% uncertainty (cost:340010); it is a buyer benchmark, not your disclosed cost.

Could you support this complete package?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Re: Seal 24 mm (part 340010) – firm two-year commitment proposal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We acknowledge your proposal for a 24-month contract at 23,400 units per year. For the increased volume and extended term, we offer EUR 31.70 per unit.

Accordingly, our Angebot stands at a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months.

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Hollerau – complete package for seal 24 mm
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised quotation and for allocating our full annual volume.

To meet you, we are moving our proposed price from EUR 29.89 to EUR 31.00/unit. We are also adding a third binding year.

Our complete package:
- EUR 31.00/unit
- 23,400 units per year, binding in each year
- 36-month contract
- your quoted 54-day lead time
- payment 30 days net, DAP, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause and no tooling

This gives you three years of firm, long-term volume in line with your capacity priorities. If you accept this complete package, we would conclude on it.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Re: Hollerau – complete package for seal 24 mm
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We note your proposal for a 36-month contract at 23,400 units per year. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We can offer EUR 31.40 per unit for this extended term. Specifically, our Angebot comprises a price of €31.40 per unit, a Lieferzeit of 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. 

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. 

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
